verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a voice AI platform that ships a CLI, SDKs and an MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for any of these surfaces. Dedicated enterprise infrastructure is a related isolation feature, not a tracking opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
